title: CodeSol
tagline: A one-stop platform for all kinds of smart contract devs to learn, practice, and showcase their solidity development skills.
description:
# ❓ Where's the Problem?
- Developers don't realize, what to learn.
- Developers need to go through a ton of job searching boards.
- Developers can't rank their solidity skills among the world.
- There is little to no multiplayer gamification for smart contract development competition.
- Recruiters take a lot of hassle and interviews to filter the best cream from the world.
- A lot of time is invested in good talent acquisition.

# 🎁 Presenting CodeSol
**CodeSol** is a competitive smart contract programming platform to enable devs to learn, practice, and showcase their solidity development skills. Here, developers are ranked according to how gas-efficient contracts the code. And, recruiters can filter out the best smart contract devs in the world in one go!

# 🤔 About the Project
- Developers always know who's ahead of them and keep improving.
- Top developers are rewarded for building the best code.
- Developers can confidently focus on improving their skills and maintain their profile to later get a job.
- There are gamification loops to keep the developers hooked.
- Recruiters can directly contact the best devs in just a few clicks.

# 🏁 Key Differentiators
✅ **Single source of truth**: Get the actual results of how good of a developer they are.

✅ **Rewards**: Incentives for writing the best code. 

✅ **Always ready to code**: All numbers are public

✅ **Gamified learning**: Always hooked into the game to become better than before.
how_its_made:
- **No remote solidity code execution solution**: we could not find any simple web2 remote solidity code compiler and executer. So, we built our own.
- **Sybil attack**: The same person can submit solutions through multiple accounts. We can solve it using world coin.
